title: First meeting with Jay McShann; Martin's-on-the-Plaza
summary: Gus meets McShann for the first time and they open at the swank Martin's on the Plaza, a job tied to Dave Dexter and friends like Churchman and Gale.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Did Jay know anything about you?
No, that was the first time we met, see.
I came there, and we started Martin's on the Plaza.
Oh, I see. What was that like?
Oh, that was a swank place.
Out There on the plaza in Kansas City.
Well, how did Jay land that?
I don't know. Someone had -- oh, I think the guy that was publishing Downbeat.
Dexter, Dave Dexter. I think he had something to do with that.
Yeah, that's right. He always befriended Jay in every day, didn't he? Wrote about him and --
Oh, sure. And another guy named Churchman.
Church was his name. He was a good friend of Jay's, too.
And he had a big pool (unintelligible).
So that's the way -- Oh, the wealthy man?
Because Jay just got through telling us, said he was a millionaire, or a wealthy man, who also helped Basie,he said. He said he did help Basie, but he always helped him.
That's right. So we got the job out there and --
